description: Election Commission - K. Jeishankar was Selected as the member of the Manmunai South and Eruvil Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Manmunai South and Eruvil Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement by a recognized political party, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7).
